args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

The function was importing and applying ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring
and the FIN-212 requirement call for ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Tests in
tests/test_money.py expect banker's rounding behavior.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was importing and applying `ROUND_HALF_UP`, contradicting its own docstring and the FIN-212 requirement of banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build's `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail (e.g. `2.665` must round to `2.66`).

## Change
- Replace `ROUND_HALF_UP` with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `src/money.py`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/money-round-half-even` (sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed**, including `tests/test_money.py`.

Note: an unrelated flaky failure in `tests/test_ledger.py::test_totals` was observed on a `main` run; not addressed here.

Fixes FIN-212.
args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money per FIN-212

1. **Diagnosed the failure**: `src/money.py` imported and used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while its docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). `tests/test_money.py` asserts `2.665 → 2.66`, which fails under half-up.
2. **Created branch** `fix/money-round-half-even` from `main` and committed the one-line fix (`ROUND_HALF_UP` → `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
3. **Ran CI** (run `ci-0001` on the branch, sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed**. (A separate `main` run had a flaky failure in `test_ledger.py::test_totals` — unrelated to this change.)
4. **Opened PR #101** against `main` titled "Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money per FIN-212", with review requested from **alex**: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

Per policy, I did not merge — it awaits code-owner approval.
